source_review.notes: Checked all six references and their cited scope. Current DORA guidance supports small batches, at-least-daily trunk integration, short branch lifetime, rapid review, few active branches, immediate build repair, and rare integration freezes as practice indicators. Fowler's 2020 branching catalog supports the distinction between private synchronization and shared integration; Branch By Abstraction supports incremental replacement behind a seam; Hodgson's 2017 feature-toggle treatment supports category, longevity, dynamism, decision separation, configuration, testing, and carrying-cost claims. Verified the Humble/Farley and Forsgren/Humble/Kim book metadata for durable delivery foundations. Checked 2026-09-06.

Checked function, vector, set-cardinality, exponent, subtraction, and comparison notation and all GitHub math delimiters.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Branch distance is deliberately a vector; scalar commit count is labeled a lossy projection rather than semantic distance.

Checked the illustrative 3-hour acceptance, 49-hour rejection, and 24-hour policy boundary in the model.
numerical_recomputation.notes: The 24-hour threshold is explicitly an example daily-integration policy, not a universal risk boundary.
